summary: Full test of Pattern Room v2 (add-signals, cluster highlight/FF Cam, Action Board with DETECTED..REJECTED lifecycle). Backend pytest (test_pattern_room_v2.py): 11/11 PASSED in ~48s. GET /api/pattern-room/signals returns pool; POST /api/pattern-room/add-signals appends, sets new_signal_indices, marks affected clusters is_new/changed (fallback into 'Yeni Sinyaller' cluster on Claude timeout — source='curated' verified), and persists (subsequent GET /signals + /analysis reflect new pool size). Empty/blank signal list returns 400. POST /api/action-board creates ActionItem with status DETECTED and created_at==updated_at (fixed by main flow to share single timestamp). GET /api/action-board lists items. PATCH updates status→REJECTED + outcome, updated_at != created_at, unknown id → 404. Regression /api/patterns, /api/pattern-room/analysis OK. Frontend playwright: Oda/Aksiyon Panosu toggle, 'Sinyal ekle' button, cluster click opens FF Cam 'Neden birlikte?' with dimming + close, move-to-board button flips to 'Panoya eklendi', Aksiyon Panosu shows board-card with status chips, editable hypothesis/outcome, Kaydet persists. Add-signals paste of 2 lines re-clusters (curated fallback path) and appends 2 new signals tagged 'yeni' in left pile (26 total, toast confirms 'Etkilenen küme: Yeni Sinyaller').

minor.issue: When Claude is slow, the internal 60s asyncio.wait_for exceeded the Cloudflare edge idle timeout (~60s) and returned 502 before the curated fallback response reached the client. Reduced wait_for timeout to 45s in analyze_pattern_room_llm; add-signals now consistently returns 200 with source='curated' in <55s.

ActionItem model called datetime.now() twice via default_factory so created_at and updated_at differed by microseconds, violating the 'created_at==updated_at on create' contract. Fixed in action_board_create by generating one 'now' string and passing to both fields.

issues: Radix DialogContent still missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby (a11y console warning) — carried over from iteration 4.

action_items: Optional: also cap /pattern-room/analyze similarly if a user manually re-triggers it while Claude is slow (already benefits from the shared 45s wait_for change).
Add DialogDescription to PatternRoom detail Dialog for a11y.

test_pattern_room.py (old iter-4 file) hardcodes 24 signals in three tests; since the pool now grows via add-signals, replace `== 24` with `>= 24`. Not blocking — pool is reset at the end of each iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1039 lines with 4 LLM workers duplicating LlmChat + regex JSON extract scaffolding. Extract _call_claude_json helper and split pattern_room into a module.

analyze_pattern_room_llm's excepts catch bare Exception (line 789) — asyncio.CancelledError is intentionally propagated in py3.11 but a broad `except` still swallows programming errors. Consider `except (asyncio.TimeoutError, json.JSONDecodeError, Exception)` explicit.

GET /api/pattern-room/analysis returns cached document without schema-version stamp; a model field addition (like new_signal_indices) would silently render stale cached rows lacking the field until pattern-room-analyze is re-invoked. Bump/invalidate cache on model change.
PATCH /action-board/{id} uses `updates = {k:v for k,v in ... if v is not None}` — cannot clear a field to empty string. Acceptable for MVP; document.
AddSignalsRequest accepts an unbounded list of strings; add a max_length (e.g., 20) and per-signal length cap (e.g., 400 chars) to prevent prompt-injection / cost blow-up.
action_board.find(...).to_list(500) — hardcoded limit + no pagination; fine for MVP but flag once the board has >500 items.
seed_data_creation: Pool + cache reset via db.pattern_room_meta.deleteMany({}) + db.pattern_room_cache.deleteMany({}) and TEST_/UI-prefixed action_board rows cleaned at the end. Environment is clean for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints (GET /pattern-room/signals, POST /pattern-room/add-signals, GET/POST/PATCH /action-board) and UI (pr-tab-room/board, pr-add-signals-btn, pr-add-dialog, pr-add-textarea, pr-add-submit-btn, pr-cluster-*, pr-why-together, pr-why-close, pr-move-to-board-btn, pr-action-board, board-card-*, board-status-*-<STATUS>, board-hypothesis-*, board-outcome-*, board-save-*) work end-to-end. LLM path returns curated fallback within ~45s (source='curated') — 'live' path also valid when Claude answers under 45s. Pool grows persistently; run the reset snippet in seed_data_creation if you re-run tests. If you want to force 'live' source, delete pattern_room_cache and hit POST /pattern-room/analyze on a warm connection.
rca of the issue: Cloudflare preview edge closes idle connections at ~60s. Prior code awaited chat.send_message with wait_for(timeout=60), so add-signals could race the edge: origin returned 200 with curated payload right around the same 60s mark, but the client had already been served a CF 502. Fix: reduced the internal Claude timeout to 45s giving ~15s headroom for curated fallback + response serialization. Verified with public URL: /pattern-room/add-signals now returns 200 in ~45-50s deterministically (source='curated' on slow Claude days) and pool + new_signal_indices are set. Separately, ActionItem used two independent default_factory=datetime.now() calls so created_at and updated_at diverged by microseconds; fixed by injecting a single now() at endpoint level.
